actuator.application_scaling: accepted CPR-Min: applied_delta = unit_direction * 0.15 * current prompt layer residual norm, slot 0
actuator.is_not: historical_d1_global_frozen (B_d1 - E), which is a different direction used by later controller work and did not produce this outcome table

capability_evaluation.note: the capability suite, the conditions and the sealed evaluation are declared in the final-evaluation manifest and are not restated here. This record's scope is the sensor checkpoint.

closes_blocker: no deployable sensor for the safety-first gate: the completed run kept out-of-fold probabilities and no weights, so the gate could be applied only by row-id lookup

development_estimates.source: recomputed by routegate.thesisresults from the frozen outcome table and the frozen gate; the derived gate matches the recorded gate_full column row for row

does_not_claim.statement: the refit produces weights and nothing else. The reported development estimates remain the out-of-fold 37/89 E substantive repairs, 0/178 material B degradations and 0/213 actionable H regressions, computed from the frozen outcome table under the frozen gate. A sensor fitted on all 480 rows has seen every one of them, so its predictions there are training-set predictions and are never reported.

name: routegate_gate_deployment_v1

representation.token_position: final token of the rendered chat prompt, before generation
representation.warning: package state 45 is NOT transformer layer 45

runtime.design: TWO-PASS prompt-level gate: an unsteered diagnostic forward pass reads state 45 at the final prompt token and yields p_E and p_H; if the gate fires the second pass generates with the frozen actuator, otherwise it generates normally.
runtime.row_id_note: the deployed gate takes an activation vector and nothing else. It consults no table, and GateBundle.decide accepts no row identifier.

sealed_evaluation.how_established: this repository stores no sealed prompt, no sealed prompt hash and no path to sealed material, and configs/paths.local.json names none. Nothing here can reach it.

development_corpus.role: the 480 development rows and their frozen final_ebh labels

residual_activations.role: the frozen feature artifact, [480, 49, 2048]; state 45 at the final prompt token is the sensor input

residual_extraction_manifest.role: the row order of the activation array

sensor_config.role: the frozen protocol every constant in this stage is transcribed from

sensor_oof_predictions.role: the frozen out-of-fold probabilities the reconstruction must reproduce before any deployment weight may be written

sensor_thresholds.role: both frozen thresholds and the frozen gate rule; read, never recomputed

static_run_config.role: the actuator, alpha, layers and generation settings the outcome table was produced under

static_steering_master.role: the frozen per-row outcome table behind the reported development estimates; read by the reporting stage, not by the fit

training.C_for_the_refit: selected by the SAME inner rule applied to all 480 rows. It is not copied from an outer fold and is not chosen by hand; the value is recorded in the checkpoint after the fit.
training.C_selection_rule: C is chosen by StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260811) inner cross-validation scored by roc_auc, maximising the mean inner score; deterministic tie-break = the smallest maximising C (first argmax over the ascending grid). This is the frozen run's own rule, applied to the fit set it is given.
training.deterministic: lbfgs on a fixed design with a fixed seed. Refitting twice on the same inputs yields byte-identical weights, and a test asserts it.

E_sensor.fitted_on: the E and B rows of the fit set

H_veto.fitted_on: all rows of the fit set

training.inner_cv: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260811) scored by roc_auc
training.outer_cv: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260811) -- the frozen fold division, reproduced and checked, used only for the reproduction gate

reproduction_gate.on_failure: nothing is written. A specification that cannot reproduce the frozen probabilities is not the specification that produced them, and a deployment artifact built from it would be a different sensor.
reproduction_gate.rule: before any deployment weight is written, the five fold sensors are reconstructed under this exact specification and their out-of-fold probabilities compared against the frozen oof_predictions.csv row for row.

training.what_is_refitted: both sensors, on all 480 development rows
training.why: to obtain final deployment weights. The completed run kept out-of-fold probabilities and no weights, so the gate could only be applied by row-id lookup.
